title: Prognostic Studies and Prediction Models — Who Will Recover?

hook.en: Patients ask the question we all dread: "Will I get better, and how long will it take?" Prognosis is the honest answer to that. Learn to read a prognostic study, tell a risk factor from a prediction tool, and avoid scaring patients with labels that the evidence cannot support.
hook.ur: Mareez woh sawal poochhte hain jis se hum sab darte hain: "Kya main theek ho jaunga, aur kitna waqt lagega?" Prognosis us ka imaandar jawab hai. Prognostic study parhna seekhein, risk factor ko prediction tool se alag karein, aur mareezon ko un labels se dara-ne se bachein jin ka saboot himayat nahi karta.

goal.en: By the end, you'll tell a prognostic factor from a prediction model, explain what makes a good prognostic study (inception cohort, adequate follow-up), know why validation matters, and communicate prognosis to patients hopefully and honestly.
goal.ur: End tak aap prognostic factor ko prediction model se alag karenge, samjhayenge ke achhi prognostic study kya banata hai (inception cohort, kaafi follow-up), jaanenge validation kyun ahem hai, aur mareezon ko prognosis ummeed aur imaandari se batayenge.

text.en: **Prognosis** is the likely course and outcome of a condition. A **prognostic factor** is something linked to the outcome, such as age or baseline pain. A **prediction model** combines several factors into one estimate of an individual's risk or outcome. The best prognostic studies follow an **inception cohort** (people at a similar early point), keep **follow-up** long and complete, and measure outcomes without knowing the predictors. A model must be **validated** in new patients before use.
text.ur: **Prognosis** kisi halat ka mumkina raasta aur nateeja hai. **Prognostic factor** woh cheez hai jo nateeje se juda ho, jaise umar ya shuruaati dard. **Prediction model** kai factors ko mila kar ek shakhs ke khatre ya nateeje ka ek andaaza deta hai. Behtareen prognostic studies **inception cohort** (aise log jo ek jaise shuruaati marhale par hon) follow karti hain, **follow-up** lamba aur mukammal rakhti hain, aur predictors jaane baghair nateeje naapti hain. Model ko istemal se pehle naye mareezon mein **validate** hona chahiye.

text.en: Think of **a weather forecast**. "70 percent chance of rain" does not promise rain, but it helps you decide about the umbrella. A forecast model is built from past weather and tested on new days. A good prediction model for recovery works like that: probabilities, tested on new patients, to guide decisions.
text.ur: **Mausam ki peshgoi** sochein. "Barish ka 70 fisad imkaan" barish ka waada nahi, lekin chhatri ka faisla karne mein madad deta hai. Peshgoi ka model guzre mausam se banta hai aur naye dinon par test hota hai. Recovery ka achha prediction model aisa hi kaam karta hai: imkaanat, naye mareezon par test shuda, faislon ki rehnumai ke liye.

title.ur: Teen cheezein jo aksar ghalat milti hain

rows.en: Something that increases the chance of getting a condition
rows.ur: Woh cheez jo halat hone ka imkaan barhati hai

rows.en: Something linked to the course of a condition that is already present
rows.ur: Mojood halat ke raaste se juda factor

rows.en: High baseline pain and a slower recovery from back pain
rows.ur: Zyada shuruaati dard aur peeth dard se dheeri recovery

rows.en: A tool combining several factors to estimate one person's outcome
rows.ur: Aala jo kai factors mila kar ek shakhs ka nateeja andaza kare

rows.en: The STarT Back tool sorting patients into low, medium and high risk of persistent pain
rows.ur: STarT Back tool jo mareezon ko dair-pa dard ke kam, darmiyani aur zyada khatre mein baante

question.en: A study recruits people at various times after back pain began, some after six months, and finds that those with high disability do worse. What is the main weakness?
question.ur: Ek study peeth dard shuru hone ke baad mukhtalif waqton par logon ko bharti karti hai, kuch chhe mahine baad, aur paati hai ke zyada disability walay behtar nahi hote. Sab se badi kamzori kya hai?

feedback.en: Mixed starting points bias the results.
feedback.ur: Mila-jula aaghaz nateejon ko bigadta hai.

text.en: The sample is too diverse to be useful
text.ur: Sample bohat mukhtalif hai jo mufeed nahi

feedback.en: Diversity is helpful if time is aligned.
feedback.ur: Agar waqt ek jaisa ho to mukhtalif hona madadgar hai.

text.en: It is not an inception cohort, so people who recover early are missed and the picture is distorted
text.ur: Yeh inception cohort nahi, isliye jaldi theek hone wale chhoot jate hain aur tasveer bigad jati hai

feedback.en: Yes — starting at a similar early point is key to fair prognosis.
feedback.ur: Haan — ek jaise shuruaati marhale se shuru karna munsifana prognosis ke liye kunji hai.

question.en: A team builds a prediction tool and reports excellent accuracy in the same patients used to build it. What should you ask?
question.ur: Ek team prediction tool banati hai aur usi mareezon mein behtareen durusti report karti hai jin se bana. Aap ko kya poochhna chahiye?

text.en: Whether the paper has a colourful chart
text.ur: Kya paper mein rang-birangi chart hai

text.en: Has it been validated in new patients, since a model nearly always performs better in the data it was built on?
text.ur: Kya naye mareezon mein validate hua, kyunke model taqreeban hamesha apne bante data mein behtar chalta hai?

feedback.en: Yes — external validation tests whether it works elsewhere.
feedback.ur: Haan — external validation jaanchti hai ke doosri jagah kaam karta hai ya nahi.

text.en: How many authors wrote the paper?

feedback.ur: Is se durusti par asar nahi padta.

question.en: A patient asks, "Will I be better in six weeks?" Which answer is best?
question.ur: Mareez poochhta hai, "Kya main chhe haftay mein theek ho jaunga?" Behtareen jawab kaun sa hai?

text.en: "Your scan shows damage, so you will probably always have pain."
text.ur: "Aap ke scan mein nuqsan hai, isliye shayad hamesha dard rahe ga."

feedback.en: That kind of language can create fear and worsen outcomes.
feedback.ur: Aisi zubaan dar paida kar ke nateeje bigad sakti hai.

text.en: "You will definitely be better in six weeks."
text.ur: "Aap yaqeenan chhe haftay mein theek ho jayenge."

feedback.en: Prognosis is a probability, not a promise.

text.en: "Most people with this problem improve a lot in six weeks, and some take longer. Here are the things that help, and we will check progress together."
text.ur: "Is masle ke zyada tar log chhe haftay mein kaafi behtar ho jate hain, aur kuch ko zyada waqt lagta hai. Yeh cheezein madad karti hain, aur hum milkar jaiza lenge."

feedback.en: Yes — it gives honest, hopeful numbers and a plan.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh imaandar, ummeed bhare numbers aur plan deta hai.

text.en: **Pinning a label on a patient.** "You are high risk" can become a self-fulfilling prophecy if it causes fear or avoidance. Prognostic tools sort groups, not destinies, and most factors explain only a small part of who recovers. Share risk gently, emphasise what can be changed, and avoid using nocebo words like "wear and tear" or "degenerate spine" without context.
text.ur: **Mareez par label chipka dena.** "Aap high risk hain" agar dar ya parhez paida kare to khud-sakhta peshgoi ban sakta hai. Prognostic tools groups ko baantte hain, taqdeer nahi, aur zyada tar factors yeh batane mein ke kaun theek hoga ek chhota hissa hi samjhate hain. Khatra narmi se batayein, jo badla ja sake us par zor dein, aur "wear and tear" ya "degenerate spine" jaise nocebo alfaaz bina context ke istemal karne se bachein.

text.en: **Use risk screening to match care, not to label.** A short tool at the first visit can sort patients so those at higher risk of persisting pain get early psychological and activity support, while low-risk patients get brief advice and reassurance. The aim is to put effort where it matters.
text.ur: **Risk screening care milane ke liye istemal karein, label lagane ke liye nahi.** Pehli visit par chhota tool mareezon ko aise baant sakta hai ke dair-pa dard ke zyada khatre wale ko shuruaati nafsiyati aur sargarmi ki madad mile, jabke kam khatre walon ko mukhtasar mashwara aur tasalli. Maqsad mehnat wahan lagana hai jahan ahem hai.

question.en: Why do prediction models often get worse in new settings?
question.ur: Prediction models naye halaat mein aksar kharab kyun ho jate hain?

answer.en: A model learns the quirks of the data it was built on (overfitting), and new patients differ in age, setting, treatment and measurement. Good models are built with enough patients and few predictors, are tested in new settings, and are recalibrated if needed. This is why the TRIPOD checklist asks authors to report validation clearly.
answer.ur: Model us data ki khasiyatein seekh leta hai jis par bana (overfitting), aur naye mareez umar, jagah, ilaaj aur naap mein mukhtalif hote hain. Achhe models kaafi mareezon aur kam predictors se banaye jate hain, naye halaat mein test hote hain, aur zaroorat par dobara calibrate hote hain. Isi liye TRIPOD checklist musannifon se validation saaf report karne ko kehti hai.

beats.patient: A therapist uses a nine-item questionnaire at the first visit and finds that a patient with sciatica has a medium risk of persistent pain, with fear of movement and low mood as flags.
beats.assessment: The tool suggests she may need more than simple advice, but it does not say she will not recover.
beats.treatment: The therapist explains what is likely, builds confidence with gradual activity, and addresses worries and sleep, with a plan to reassess in two weeks.
beats.reassess: At two weeks, the patient is moving more and less afraid, and the plan continues without a label.

text.en: **Prognosis tools do not replace red-flag screening.** A low-risk score for persistent pain does not exclude serious disease. Always screen for red flags first, then use prognostic tools to guide care among patients who are safe to treat.
text.ur: **Prognosis tools red-flag screening ki jagah nahi lete.** Dair-pa dard ka kam khatre ka score seriyas bimari ko khaarij nahi karta. Pehle hamesha red flags ki screening karein, phir un mareezon mein care ki rehnumai ke liye prognostic tools istemal karein jo ilaaj ke liye mehfooz hon.

text.en: The QUIPS tool assesses bias in studies of prognostic factors across six areas: participation, attrition, prognostic factor measurement, outcome measurement, confounding and statistical analysis. The TRIPOD statement provides a checklist for transparent reporting of studies that develop or validate multivariable prediction models, and stresses clear reporting of model performance and validation.
text.ur: QUIPS aala prognostic factors ki studies mein bias ko chhe hissoon mein parakhta hai: shirkat, attrition, prognostic factor ki pemaish, outcome ki pemaish, confounding aur shumariyati tajziya. TRIPOD statement un studies ki shaffaf report ke liye checklist deta hai jo multivariable prediction models banati ya validate karti hain, aur model ki karkardagi aur validation ki saaf report par zor deta hai.

text.en: **Inception, Follow-up, Validate, Gentle.** Start at an early point, follow completely, validate the model and share prognosis gently.
text.ur: **Aaghaz, Follow-up, Validate, Narmi.** Shuruaati marhale se shuru, mukammal follow-up, model validate karein aur prognosis narmi se batayein.

summary.en: Prognostic studies follow an inception cohort with complete follow-up; prediction models must be validated in new patients.
summary.ur: Prognostic studies inception cohort ko mukammal follow-up ke saath dekhti hain; prediction models ko naye mareezon mein validate hona chahiye.

summary.en: Risk factors, prognostic factors and prediction models are different things.
summary.ur: Risk factors, prognostic factors aur prediction models mukhtalif cheezein hain.

summary.en: Share prognosis as a probability with hope and a plan, avoid labels, and screen red flags first.
summary.ur: Prognosis ko imkaan ke taur par ummeed aur plan ke saath batayein, labels se bachein, aur pehle red flags dekhein.

back.en: People enrolled at a similar early point in their condition and followed forward.
back.ur: Aise log jo halat ke ek jaise shuruaati marhale par bharti hon aur aage follow hon.

back.en: A tool that combines several factors to estimate one person's outcome or risk.
back.ur: Aala jo kai factors mila kar ek shakhs ka nateeja ya khatra andaza kare.

front.en: Why validate a model in new patients?
front.ur: Model naye mareezon mein kyun validate karein?

back.en: Models usually perform worse outside the data they were built on.
back.ur: Models aam taur par apne bante data se bahar kharab chalte hain.

front.en: Is a prognostic tool a promise?

back.en: No; it gives probabilities for groups, not certainties for individuals.
back.ur: Nahi; yeh groups ke imkaanat deta hai, afraad ke liye yaqeen nahi.

note.ur: Labels aur anchoring kaise gumrah karte hain.
